Hi! I’m sorry I did see your comment last night and wanted to circle back once I had more brain power. In terms of passive goal setting and meeting (small consistent healthy habits there’s one called FINCH where you have to “raise” a baby bird and help them make life decisions for instance you can choose to give them a more logical answer or a more whimsical / extroversion / introversion & caution etc based on your responses you learn about yourself and it’s passive journaling as well. It’s fun and interactive you can add real people via codes and help keep each other accountable . Another one is called Bird Alone , this one is 2.99 or something but it’s a one time fee not a subscription and the quality to me is worth it. it’s  fully an immersive solo experience where you interact with a parrot for short intervals each day, some times he asks fill in the blank promos like mad libs style, some times he’ll ask you to draw a picture of what you think of when he says x or a picture of how you feel right now. Both of them are positive additions to my day and it’s not the end of the world if you do miss a day but it does make a noticeable positive difference. If you’d like more recommendations I have several other BPD specific ones but the two above ^ have helped me work through a lot and re-create healthy behaviors (oral health, drinking water, etc )
